description: Autologic Industries is a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Colombia, exporting quality-checked clutch and engine spares for many bike models.
banner_desc: Clutch and engine spares for the motorcycles behind Colombia’s deliveries, commutes and mototaxis.
hero_sub: Spares for the Bikes That Keep Colombia Moving
hero: In Colombia the motorcycle is a work tool as much as a vehicle: it delivers food, carries mototaxi passengers and gets commuters across congested cities. As a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Colombia, we help distributors keep those bikes on the road with clutch and engine spares for several popular models.
All parts come from our own IATF 16949 certified factory in India, where CNC machining, die casting and heat treatment happen under one roof. That control keeps each reorder identical to the last.
Containers arrive with every model boxed and labelled separately, so your warehouse team can put stock away without opening cartons to check contents.
Our team can also suggest which lines to add as your range grows, based on the models your customers bring in most.
